raw_reason: Withdrawn to Publish in Different Journal
canonical_reason: Withdrawn to Publish in Different Journal
definition_used: The article was taken from one journal/platform or access type to be published in a different journal/platform or with a different access type.
caution: This is a status/notice term describing a withdrawal for republication elsewhere. It does not directly indicate a problem with research content, authorship, or peer review integrity, but it relates to editorial governance and post-publication transparency. Main figure not recommended because the reason is primarily a publication-process metadata signal rather than a substantive integrity issue.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a withdrawal to republish in a different journal or platform, which involves editorial governance (handling of manuscript transfers) and post-publication transparency (notice of withdrawal). It does not inherently imply unreliability of research content or authorship/attribution issues.
